call.code:
import csv, os, re
p = os.path.join(os.environ["PANTHEON_PROJECTS"], "crm/contacts.csv")
out = p[:-4] + ".clean.csv"; assert out != p
rows = list(csv.DictReader(open(p, newline="", encoding="utf-8-sig"))); cols = list(rows[0])
fixed = {"dates": 0, "emails": 0, "names": 0, "phones": 0}; invalid = []
for i, r in enumerate(rows, 2):
    for c in cols: r[c] = r[c].strip()
    m = re.fullmatch(r"(\d\d)/(\d\d)/(\d{4})", r["joined"])
    if m: r["joined"] = f"{m[3]}-{m[2]}-{m[1]}"; fixed["dates"] += 1
    if r["email"] != r["email"].lower(): r["email"] = r["email"].lower(); fixed["emails"] += 1
    if r["name"].isupper() or r["name"].islower(): r["name"] = r["name"].title(); fixed["names"] += 1
    ph = re.sub(r"(?!^\+)[^0-9]", "", r["phone"])
    if ph != r["phone"]: r["phone"] = ph; fixed["phones"] += 1
    if not r["email"]: invalid.append((i, "email", "", "required, blank"))
    elif "@" not in r["email"]: invalid.append((i, "email", r["email"], "no @"))
seen, keep, dup = set(), [], 0
for r in rows:
    k = tuple(r[c] for c in cols)
    if k in seen: dup += 1; continue
    seen.add(k); keep.append(r)
by = {}
near = [(by.setdefault(r["email"], i), i) for i, r in enumerate(keep, 2) if r["email"] and by.get(r["email"], i) != i]
w = csv.DictWriter(open(out, "w", newline="", encoding="utf-8"), cols); w.writeheader(); w.writerows(keep)
print("wrote", os.path.relpath(out, os.environ["PANTHEON_PROJECTS"]), len(rows), "in", len(keep), "out")
print("fixed", fixed, "duplicates", dup); print("near", near); print("invalid", invalid)
